posts.cooked:
The Commons Configuration Dashboard (CCD) Parameters category is for posts explaining key parameters that you will set to design the economy for the Commons Upgrade. Your economy, Your Choice!

This category should contain posts that explain each of the basic parameters, in detail, along with design considerations and a suggested range.

This category is separate from the other categories explaining TEC parameters because we are using unique (new and improved!) parameter names in the Commons Configuration Dashboard, and these terms may not be consistent with previous posts explaining the same concepts.

The purpose here is to make the dashboard easy-to-understand and to empower our community with all the tools they need to design the economy!
